overview.description: T. Rowe Price Mid Cap Equity Research ETF is an actively managed exchange-traded fund that seeks long-term capital growth by investing primarily in U.S. mid-cap companies. The fund uses a research-driven approach to construct a portfolio with characteristics similar to the Russell Mid-Cap Index, while overweighting companies viewed favorably and underweighting or avoiding those viewed less favorably.

data.title: T. Rowe Price Launches Three Active Equity ETFs
data.text: T. Rowe Price Group launched three active equity ETFs Thursday. The funds target biotechnology, small-cap and mid-cap stocks, the company said.
